answer: Since the throttle counters live in the violet ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 275 keys hence pays for 275 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the inlet quota and the spiral admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
